name: mirage
text: Done in code. For a market you hold on both sides where Novig's payout fits neither side, the Tracker now takes the winner from the public final score, books the winning side at what Novig actually paid, and marks the other side lost. Your DET -7.5 bet will grade that way. The settler tests pass. It isn't in the app yet: it goes out with the next release, after the full test run.
